'''Prateon''' was a hypothetical, mysterious, invisible, and scarcely studied element, the existence of which was not yet proved. Nevertheless, it was believed that it was a channel of rising prateon that caused the landing [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to lose control, slow down and be pulled down as if by remote control until the lower altitudes, where the control was resumed.<ref name="WOSWFG">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
